name: offeragent-obsidian
description: Interview prep and offer workflow assistant for Obsidian
author: OfferAgent

scripts.build: npm run protocol:generate && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.build:local: npm run protocol:generate && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs local-development
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
